name: atlanai-mods
description: Claude Code mod for the Atlan registry: registry reads run without a prompt, writes ask first, archive and move show what depends on the artifact, temporary gateway errors tell Claude how to retry, Atlan calls read as one line in the transcript, a pane lists what the session touched, a band follows a skill publish, /atlan skills picks a skill to load, a registry skill that clearly fits a request is named to Claude, and the status line reports a broken or degraded Atlan connection.

confirm_writes.title: Ask before registry writes
confirm_writes.description: Ask before Claude creates or changes anything in Atlan. Archive, approve, move, release and roll-back always ask.

suggest_skills.title: Suggest registry skills
suggest_skills.description: Search your organization's Atlan skills with each request, and name one to Claude when it clearly fits. The first 300 characters of the request are sent to Atlan's search.
